why: tokenAmount: 10% of the 1M TKN treasury, the amount to sell.
stableAmount: Matches the token side by value so the anchor stays thick.
price: No price given; kept the form's current opening price.
tickSpacing: The usual spacing; nothing asked for otherwise.
rangePct: Default width, comfortably covers the 300-tick half-width.
positionPct: Default: half of each side starts in the position.
anchorPct: A little above 20% to clear the 19% anchor minimum.
floorPct: Default depth floor.
auctionHours: One day of bidding, usual for a real mandate.
minBond: You asked for a bond of at least 25k.
epochHours: Weekly epochs across the quarter.
epochs: Twelve weeks is a quarter.
uptimePct: Default uptime.
managerFeePct: Default manager share.
twapMins: Default window, hard to push for a mid-size pool.
maxTickDeviation: About 1%, the default gap.
minHalfWidth: Default, above the 100-tick gap.
minFeePct: Your fee floor of 0.05%.
maxFeePct: Your fee cap of 0.5%.
startStablePct: The deposit opens at 50% stablecoin; a little headroom.
endStablePct: All 100k TKN may be sold into USDC by the end.
assumptions: The opening price stays at 2 USDC per TKN.
The deposit is the 100k TKN to sell plus 200k USDC to pair it.
Weekly epochs, so the quarter is 12 of them.
questions: Which addresses are TKN and USDC on this network? The form keeps the ones already filled in.
